description: /create-api-doc is a thin wrapper of api-doc-writer: it binds the slug to the input file /api-docs/api-references/<slug>.md. With no such file it stops, names the file, and writes no page. A live run of the page itself is tc-40a. Covers the command only.
setup: printf '%s\n' '- **API reference root:** `api-reference/`' >> CLAUDE.md && git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'

assertions.name: says the file is missing
assertions.pattern: doesn.t exist|does not exist|not found|no such|missing|couldn.t find|isn.t there|absent
